text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Takarazuka Kinen arrived. 
Up until this day, I took the utmost care 
regarding Sakura Chiyono O's physical 
condition.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I've got all the training details up to 
today completely memorized!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'll be running to take 1st place 
today too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O is acting brave. As if 
trying to keep things feeling just the 
same as they were before the talk about 
her peak.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just a brave front to hide 
her true feelings. If she wishes for me to 
treat her no differently...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Hehe. Hearing you cheer for me like 
that, Trainer, really makes me feel like 
the race is about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I've been preparing thoroughly for the 
Takarazuka Kinen, so I'll make sure to 
show you the fruits of my labor in the 
main event.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Because I believe... even if it's true 
that my peak has passed."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
As long as you keep looking forward and 
keep trying, something's bound to bear 
fruit!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"No matter who the opponent is today, I 
have no intention of losing!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, the Spring Grand Prix, the 
'Takarazuka Kinen'! The spotlight 
Umamusume have made their dashing 
entrance!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Who among them will seize the glory?! The 
race is about to start!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Yaeno-san... She's probably gotten even 
stronger since the Classic season.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Bamboo-san is right in her prime growth 
period. I think she runs with tremendous 
power.)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
(Inari-san's been in the spotlight ever 
since the start of the year. Her strength 
is no doubt guaranteed...)
